description: Work screen, other screens, header and tab bar (3 commits). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Commit 4: Work screen (js/screens/work.js markup only if needed, mostly CSS): step in large card 1.5-1.75rem, thin progress bar plus keep 'Step N of M' text, ALL FIVE answer buttons (Done, Still working, Stuck, Drifted, Later) stay identical in look (AGENTS rule 6, home-screen.spec.js:34): make them one equal, large, comfortable grid/row, NOT Done-as-primary, extras in a separate quiet group, FIX countdown label overlapping Show all my steps. Keep focus behavior and DOM order.

Commit 5: apply tokens/cards/button hierarchy to steps preview (Start primary), steps editor, calendar, Plan, Me, Talk (CSS only, no chat.js edits), Settings; list items with spacing and subtle dividers.
Commit 6: header polish (title text 'Focus app' kept, easy to change in index.html), tab bar clearer selected state, good tap size, never covers content (tabs.spec.js).
acceptance_criteria: Work screen shows no overlapping controls at 360px and 1280px
The five answer buttons look identical (rule 6) and are large and evenly laid out
Tab bar does not cover last control on Today, Plan, Me
verification: relevant browser specs: work-screen, work-extras, during-a-step, steps-editor, calendar, plan-tab, me-export, settings, tabs, navigation
findings: Answer buttons kept equal (rule 6); progress bar is a native progress element added in work.js. Isolated specs all pass.
